title: Route notes from Prusik Peak's West Ridge
summary: A Mountaineers intermediate-climb team reported on the West Ridge, including a route-finding lesson about avoiding rope drag on the first pitch. The club's report emphasizes sharing specific, experience-based route observations.
imageAlt: A climber moving on steep mountain terrain

title: A late-season scramble includes a lost-hiker assist
summary: A Mountaineers report describes a Vesper and Wolf Peaks scramble and helping a lost hiker reconnect with their group during the descent. The report is a timely reminder to check in with other parties and offer appropriate assistance.
imageAlt: Hikers traveling together on a mountain trail

title: Volunteer outings contribute to alpine meadow monitoring
summary: A MeadoWatch outing at Mount Rainier's Reflection Lakes contributed observations to ongoing work tracking alpine meadow wildflowers. The club report connects recreation with long-term monitoring of mountain ecosystems.
imageAlt: An alpine valley and surrounding mountain slopes

title: Air quality changed the plan for a glacier climb
summary: The club's Sloan Peak report notes that the climb was rescheduled after poor air quality earlier in the month. The team's decision is a practical example of using smoke and air-quality information when deciding whether to travel.
imageAlt: Clouds and changing weather over a mountain ridge

title: A member group completes the Walker's Haute Route
summary: A Global Adventures group documented a hut-to-hut journey from Mont Blanc toward the Matterhorn between August 15 and 31. Its report shares route impressions from one of the Alps' best-known long-distance treks.
imageAlt: A mountain lake beneath a high alpine range

title: A North Cascades glacier traverse shares team lessons
summary: A Mountaineers team reported on a multi-day Inspiration–McAllister–Klawatti Ice Cap traverse. The published account describes changing the objective as fatigue and illness affected the group, and shortening the traverse accordingly.
imageAlt: Snow-covered mountain peaks above a glacier

title: A climber-focused durable down parka is announced for 2026
summary: Outside's Spring 2026 gear preview describes Patagonia's Durable Down Parka as part of its Free Wall kit for climbers. The article highlights its tear-resistant face fabric, 800-fill down and intended use in cold outdoor conditions.
imageAlt: Snow-covered trees in a winter mountain forest
